leads.name: Horse Chestnut of Viale delle Rimembranze, Torre Boldone
leads.why: Register sheet 01/L251/BG/03, girth 391cm, height 27m. Publicly documented as Torre Boldone's 'last surviving monumental tree' after another was illegally felled. An agronomist assessed it as declining in 2017; the comune then illegally pollarded it ('heavy pruning without any authorisation', reducing height by roughly a third) in January 2018, and a large limb failed and fell in June 2021 (Araberara, 4 June 2021), the last dated confirmation found. No source since 2021 confirms current health, and the register's girth/height figures may predate the 2018 pollarding. Worth a fresh check (recent local press or a photo) before shipping; isolated from the other candidates (nearest is Seriate, 2.5km away) so it does not join a walk on its own.

leads.name: Zanica Villa Comunale: two Himalayan cedars and a giant sequoia
leads.why: MASAF sheets 01/M147/BG/03 (Cedrus deodara, girth 478 cm, 24 m), 02/M147/BG/03 (Cedrus deodara, 420 cm, 22 m), 03/M147/BG/03 (Sequoiadendron giganteum, 420 cm, 22 m), Parco della villa comunale, Via Roma 35, Zanica (public municipal park, ex Villa Spasciani; comune page lists it as a park, territorialmentebergamo.wordpress.com 2020 says the park is worth a walk 'per osservare le piante monumentali'). Park-level register coordinates only (cedars at 45.643561,9.683028 and 45.643528,9.683056, sequoia at 45.643306,9.68375), so approximate, a park is not a small site, and no photograph or open-licensed geotagged image found (Commons has only File:Zanica municipio.jpg). Italy is a covered country: needs photo or confirmed pin. lifecheck NONE. Reason: no photo or exact pin in reach. A reader's GPS fix or a photo would ship it. About 6.4 km from Bergamo centre; Zanica is on the Bergamo-Treviglio railway (not timed).
leads.write_pass_2026_11_02: Held as a lead by the write pass 2026-11-02: three park-level register points, no photo or confirmed pin, and Italy is a covered country; a reader's GPS fix or photo ships it.

blocked.name: Japanese Pagoda Tree of Villa Ambiveri
blocked.reason: Register sheet 12/I628/BG/03, girth 380cm/32m. Villa Ambiveri (Via Tasca 36, Seriate) is privately owned by the Fondazione Centro Studi Russia Cristiana since 1958; only its library keeps regular public hours (Tue-Fri, 9:00-12:30), and the English-style garden containing the tree is described as opening only occasionally for special events. Not genuinely open to visitors under hard rule 10.

blocked.name: London Plane of Ospedale Bolognini
blocked.reason: Register sheet 08/I628/BG/03, girth 465cm/33.5m. Confirmed to exist in a 'healing garden' near the hospital's surgery pavilion. RECHECKED 2026-08-15 against hard rule 10's current three-test standard (2026-08-13 loosening, not the superseded 'when in doubt leave it out' this entry originally cited): the hospital's own published visiting hours are tight (1-2:30pm and 7-8:30pm), which is the pattern of a reception/appointment gate rather than open ground, and no source describes the garden as open to non-patients. Stays blocked on that basis, not on the old default. Worth a direct check with the hospital if this city is revisited.
